name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Envy goes with exactly one of Bathing, Gardening, or Walking.
Fairfax, Envy, and Revenge go with Painting, Sleeping, and Walking, in some order.
Greed goes with at least one of Pierce, Sleeping, or Walking.
Between Bathing and Walking, one goes with Crane and the other with Inheritance.
If either Fairfax goes with Jealousy or Jealousy goes with Sleeping (but not both), then both Crane goes with Walking and Ashford does not go with Bathing.
Exactly one of these is true: Fairfax goes with Walking; Inheritance goes with Sleeping; Jealousy goes with Painting.
